---
name: solution-design
description: "Turn accepted requirements and architecture into implementation-ready UI, API, behavior, accessibility, and edge-case specifications."
---
# Solution Design

1. Use the requirement, plan, and architecture handoffs as constraints.
2. Specify the user/API flow and expected inputs, outputs, and state transitions relevant to the change.
3. Cover loading, empty, success, validation, and error states when applicable.
4. For UI changes, account for existing visual patterns, keyboard use, accessible labels/focus, and responsive layouts.
5. For backend changes, define validation, response/error behavior, and compatibility expectations.
6. Map design decisions to acceptance criteria and call out unresolved trade-offs. Do not edit files.
